newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE amends trading hours for 3-mth Euromarks.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE amends trading hours for 3-mth Euromarks.

text.p: The London International Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Friday it had revised trading hours for its three-month Euromark futures and options contracts.
The revision will accompany the introduction of two serial delivery months and four additional quarterly delivery months for the futures contract, LIFFE said in a statement.
The additional months will create the first European short-term interest rate contract with expiry dates four years in the future, LIFFE said.
The new hours for futures trade will run from 0730 to 1610 GMT, and for options from 0732 to 1610 GMT.
The change will take effect from Monday, January 13.
